div.head: Geþyn. 7
div.ab: And gif leornere wære, þe þurh lare geþuge, þæt he had hæfde 7 þenode Criste, wǽre se siððan mæðe 7 munde swa micelre wyrðe, swa ðonne þam hade gebirede, mid rihte, gif he hine heolde, swa swa he scolde.

And if there were a scholar who prospered with his learning so that he took orders and served Christ, he should afterwards be entitled to so much more honour and protection as belonged by rights to that order, if he kept himself [chaste] as he should.
7 gif leornere geþeh þurh láre, þæt he hád hæfde 7 þenode Christe, se wæs þonne syððan mæðe 7 munde swa micelre wyrðe, swa ðærto gebyrede, buton he forworhte, þæt he þære hádnote notian ne moste.

And if student prospered by his learning, so that he took orders and served Christ, he was afterwards worthy of such respect and protection as was fitting thereto, unless he should sin so that he could not practice his ministry.
